ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (off-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-intensity region on the distal portion of the left lobe; series of vertical, high-contrast light-intensity streaks and bands distributed across the outer half of the right lobe; central region and proximal lobes are predominantly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and moderate depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, moderate-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys along the trailing edge, with discernible jaggedness on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer trailing edges terminating in sharp, slightly swept-back tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct vertical parallel pigment banding pattern localized on the ventral surface of the right fluke lobe.
